description:
Job Title: Python Fullstack Engineer Location: (Jaipur) Experience Level: 5+ Years Employment Type: Full-time 
 We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Python Backend Engineer who can take ownership of designing and developing scalable backend systems. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Python, React OR Angular cloud architecture using AWS, and leading backend teams in delivering robust and high-performance applications. This role will also require hands-on coding, architecture planning, and mentoring team members . Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead the design, development, and deployment of backend systems using Python frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask) and React OR Angular Architect scalable and maintainable solutions leveraging AWS cloud services (e.g.,EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway, CloudFormation). Ensure high standards in code quality, performance, and scalability. Mentor junior developers and perform regular code reviews. Manage sprint planning, task estimation, and delivery in Agile/Scrum environments.

Deep hands-on experience with AWS Cloud Services and infrastructure design. Proficient in working with databases PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB etc. Experience with containerization tools like Docker, and orchestration (e.g., ECS, EKS, Kubernetes). CI/CD pipeline design using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team Strong communication and leadership skills.
